**3B.6 Research Note**

**Assessment:** mixed to negative. Jokowi’s 2024 public rhetoric was generally restraint-oriented and anti-escalatory, but the domestic record still shows a meaningful fear climate in Papua and around protests, especially through detentions, content restrictions, and coercive crowd control. I did not find evidence that he replaced insecurity with systematic state terror on the scale of a mass campaign, but the negative signals are real and recurrent.

**Accepted Claims**
- **President Jokowi Tegaskan Dialog Adalah Solusi Terbaik untuk Konflik di Timur Tengah** | **Presidential Secretariat of the Republic of Indonesia** | **2024-10-05** | [URL](https://presidenri.go.id/siaran-pers/presiden-jokowi-tegaskan-dialog-adalah-solusi-terbaik-untuk-konflik-di-timur-timur/) | Jokowi said dialogue is the best way to reduce escalation and urged all parties to restrain themselves. This is direct de-escalatory rhetoric that cuts against a deliberate fear-building posture. | **3B.6**, **3B.3**, **2B.7**
- **Indonesia condemns Israeli attacks on Gaza, Lebanon, UN peacekeepers** | **Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia** | **2024-10-15** | [URL](https://setkab.go.id/en/indonesia-condemns-israeli-attacks-on-gaza-lebanon-un-peacekeepers/) | Jokowi condemned attacks on civilians and UN peacekeepers and called for restraint and an end to armed conflict. This supports a restrained public posture rather than one that normalizes fear or revenge. | **3B.6**, **3B.3**, **2B.7**
- **Human Rights Reports: Indonesia** | **U.S. Department of State** | **published 2025-08-12; covers 2024** | [URL](https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2128570.html) | The report says police temporarily detained critics and peaceful demonstrators, especially in Papua, and that the government did not systematically investigate abuses. This is strong negative evidence for a fear-reducing posture. | **3B.6**, **3B.5**, **3B.2**, **3B.1**, **2B.9**
- **Freedom on the Net 2024: Indonesia** | **Freedom House** | **2024** | [URL](https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-net/2024) | Freedom House says Kominfo can directly restrict online content without an appeals process, and that connectivity restrictions continued during protests and in Papua. That is evidence of a broader political fear climate and administrative control. | **3B.6**, **3B.5**, **3B.4**, **3B.3**
- **Indonesia shelves plan to revise election law as protests rage** | **Reuters / Investing.com** | **2024-08-22** | [URL](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/protests-across-indonesia-as-parliament-delays-change-to-election-law-3582501) | Reuters reported security forces used tear gas and water cannon against protesters during the election-law crisis. This supports a negative finding because coercive crowd control can deepen domestic fear rather than reduce it. | **3B.6**, **3B.5**, **3B.2**
- **Human Rights Watch report on Papuans** | **Human Rights Watch** | **2024-09-18** | [URL](https://www.hrw.org/report/2024/09/18/if-its-not-racism-what-is-it/discrimination-and-other-abuses-against-papuans-in) | HRW says security forces committed arbitrary arrests, torture, extrajudicial killings, and mass forced displacement in Papua, and were seldom held to account. That is strong evidence against a fear-reducing security environment. | **3B.6**, **3B.2**, **3B.1**, **2B.9**
- **Annual Overview 2024** | **Human Rights Monitor** | **2024** | [URL](https://humanrightsmonitor.org/reports/annual-report-2024-human-rights-and-conflict-in-west-papua/) | The report says there were no public trials from police or military abuse cases in 2024, internal investigations were opaque, punishment was weak, and misinformation was used to blunt accountability pressure. That is consistent with a broader climate of fear and impunity. | **3B.6**, **3B.4**, **3B.2**, **2B.9**
- **Papuans Behind Bars: Annual Overview 2024** | **Papuans Behind Bars** | **2025-07-23; covers 2024** | [URL](https://papuansbehindbars.org/annual-overview-2024/) | The overview recorded 370 political arrests in 2024, with most detainees released within hours or days. That suggests repeated coercive pressure and short-term intimidation even where imprisonment was not always prolonged. | **3B.6**, **3B.2**, **3B.1**, **2B.9**

**Search Gap**
- I did **not** find evidence that Jokowi used a nationwide terror campaign or a formal emergency regime to generate fear in 2024.
- I also did **not** find strong proof that his government successfully reduced domestic insecurity without relying on coercive policing, content restrictions, or opaque accountability in Papua.
- The record is best described as **restraint-oriented rhetoric with coercive domestic security practice in key flashpoints**.
